owner_creation.analysis: cmdbuf: The fixed [c_char; 2048] owns command bytes and the terminating NUL; cp and cmd_offset describe positions within this static owner.
owner_creation.invariant: The command array owns bytes independently of cursor aliases.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.

aliases_escapes.analysis: cmdbuf: get_cmdbuf returns a borrowed raw C-string address and edit helpers retain interior pointers; the ABI expresses no lifetime preventing a later edit while a reader uses it.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Escaped command-string borrows must not span mutation.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.

callback_targets.analysis: cmdbuf: Editing calls character-width, repaint and output functions directly; native terminal callbacks can reach display code while command bytes are partway through editing.
callback_targets.invariant: Direct editing calls do not protect shared display aliases.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.

invalidation.analysis: cmdbuf: Reset, insertion, erasure and history/completion edits rewrite the array in place; stable address does not preserve old text seen by a retained pointer.
invalidation.invariant: In-place edits invalidate the contents of prior borrows.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.

mutation_commit.analysis: cmdbuf: cmd_ichar checks current strlen plus input length, shifts suffix bytes and writes new bytes before repaint; this remains a raw multi-step update rather than a staged owner replacement.
mutation_commit.invariant: Capacity checks and logical edit publication remain separate.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.

release_pair.analysis: cmdbuf: The array must never be freed; owned history/completion copies are separate heap objects whose destruction cannot release this static storage.
release_pair.invariant: Command-array addresses are not heap allocations.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.

error_cleanup.analysis: cmdbuf: A full command returns action 2 before insertion; other raw range/alias contracts and display errors are not encoded as a failure-preserving borrowed-string API.
error_cleanup.invariant: Rejected capacity must not publish partial new text.
